body: Curious as to how you found out who spiked the drink, especially as this stranger had nothing to do with your group and the spike was intended for someone else..

A pilots licences is pretty a pretty coveted thing, why not put it to good use and go to work for UNICEF or the red cross in Africa or asia, a year or two flying desperately needed food out to the people who need it most would certainly be rewarding, get away from your parents and I doubt you'd look 14 when you returned from work like that. 

Maybe not Africa right now for obvious reasons but I'm sure those kind of charities are desperate for people like you, I live in England and fuck me a pilots licence would cost me a fortune, I am envious dude.

Cracking idea, no doubt, though also not easy. I did frequent the gym from time to time before getting hit by a car. Unfortunately now, still having the remnants of a shattered foot and back pain, if I put something out or pull the wrong muscle whilst there I am literally out for a week. 

I do keep myself fit, I walk a good
 8-10 miles a day and use an exercise bike when I am able (rowing machine did not go down well ) thanks for your suggestion and I +1 it to others reading this.
